summary: The java sidecar P1's gate runs on is not in the pod: `cexec java` fails with 'tool "java" is not available in this environment; the tools it has are: aac-tools, go, iac'. Close-out A1 is still open: Ansible 9edef16 and DockerImages 1c1945a are unpushed (main ahead of origin by 2 and by 1), and there has been no `kc env restart`. The plan rules out every fallback (a hand-downloaded runtime or Central's 1.31), so no code was written. Re-dispatch P1 after the pushes, the iac-toolchain publish and the restart.
